hints: Dijkstra cannot be rescued here. Its correctness depends on non-negative weights, so you need Bellman-Ford, which relaxes every edge repeatedly instead of committing to a vertex.
Initialise every dist to 0 rather than picking a source. That is the same as adding an imaginary vertex with a free edge to everywhere, and it makes cycles in ANY component detectable.
After n-1 full passes all genuine shortest paths have settled. Run one more pass: if any edge can still be relaxed, a negative cycle exists.
source: NITC_Lab_S3_DSA Week 4 - SSSP, Practice Question 4 (optional on the sheet)
